description: The complete Greece income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: 2026 scale for employment, pension and business income with the lower rates for children and for under-30s; Tax reduction (μείωση φόρου) by children with its phase-out; EFKA employee contributions with the monthly ceiling, and the self-employed categories; Freelancers: minimum presumed income (art. 28A-28Γ) with its reductions, loss carry-forward, advance tax; Rent at the 2026 scale (15/25/35/45%), dividends 5%, interest 15%, royalties 20%, share gains 15% with exemptions; Electronic spending requirement and the 22% shortfall tax, with exemptions and spouse transfer; Joint or separate returns for married couples, compared; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in EUR; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: An individual's (or a married couple's) Greek income tax return (δήλωση Ε1), tax year 2026. Every amount is in euros for the whole year; leave out what does not apply.

children.description: Dependent children (εξαρτώμενα τέκνα): lower rates and a larger tax reduction, for both spouses. Default 0

disabled_dependants.description: Dependants with a disability of 67% or more: €200 tax reduction each (art. 17). Default 0

filing.description: Married couples: joint (one return, each taxed separately, refunds set off, electronic spending surplus shared) or separate returns. Default joint

discount_pct.description: Discount for paying everything by the first instalment date (end of July): 4% if filed by 30 April, 3% by 15 June, 2% by 15 July (2026 filing dates), or 0. Default 0

months_late.description: Months the balance is paid late (0.73% interest a month)

spouse.description: The spouse or civil partner, if married (leave out if single)

age.description: Age reached in 2026. Up to 25: 0% on the first €20,000; 26 to 30: 9%. 70+: no electronic spending requirement. Default 40

efka_auxiliary.description: Auxiliary pension branch (επικουρική) category: 0 none, 1 (€46.57/month), 2 (€56.13), 3 (€66.88). Default 0

efka_category.description: EFKA insurance category for the self-employed: none, special (€150.46/month), 1 (€250.77) to 6 (€675.87). Default none

efka_unemployment.description: Pay the €10 a month unemployment contribution (former OAEE members)

expenses.description: Business expenses, excluding EFKA contributions, euros for 2026

losses_brought_forward.description: Business losses of the last 5 years not yet used, euros for 2026

other_contributions.description: Other compulsory contributions paid, euros for 2026

payroll_cost.description: Total yearly payroll cost (10% is added to the minimum presumed income, max €15,000), euros for 2026

presumed.description: Minimum presumed income (ελάχιστο τεκμαρτό εισόδημα): apply, contest (rebuttal: the declared profit is taxed), exempt (disability 80%+, up to 3 clients on a services contract, new mothers...). Default apply

presumed_half.description: 50% reduction of the minimum presumed income: large family, disability 67-79%, single parent, settlement up to 1,500 people outside Attica, taxi share up to 25%

sector_average_turnover.description: AADE average turnover for your activity code (5% of your turnover above it is added to the minimum presumed income); 0 if unknown, euros for 2026

top_employee_salary.description: Gross yearly pay of your best-paid employee (used when it exceeds the presumed amount, up to €30,000), euros for 2026

withheld.description: 20% withheld by clients on invoices, euros for 2026

year_of_activity.description: Year of activity in 2026 (1 = started in 2026). Years 1-3: no minimum presumed income. Default 10

losses_brought_forward.description: Capital losses of the last 5 years not yet used, euros for 2026

holding_pct.description: Your share of the company, percent (listed shares under 0.5% are exempt)

disabled_67.description: Disability of 67% or more (or war victim and similar): €200 tax reduction (art. 17)

donations.description: Donations to approved bodies (δωρεές): 20% tax reduction if donations exceed €100, counted up to 5% of income, euros for 2026

donations_charity.description: Donations to charitable foundations and registered civil-society organisations via special bank accounts: 40% tax reduction, counted up to 40% of income, euros for 2026

e_spending.description: Electronic spending requirement (30% of income spent by card/e-banking; 22% tax on the shortfall)

amount.description: Spending by card or e-banking that counts (leave out to assume the requirement is met), euros for 2026

exempt.description: Exempt: disability 80%+, village under 500 people, long-term patient, prisoner, military service (70+ and non-residents are exempt automatically)

high_burden.description: Tax, ENFIA, loan and rent paid electronically exceed 60% of income: requirement 20%

benefits_in_kind.description: Benefits in kind (company car, housing...), euros for 2026

custom_contributions.description: Compulsory contributions paid, when social is custom, euros for 2026

payments.description: Salary paid in 14 instalments (12 months + bonuses) or 12. Default 14

salary.description: Gross salary including Christmas, Easter and holiday bonuses, euros for 2026

social.description: Social security: efka (employee rate 13.37% up to €7,761.94 a month), none (not insured in Greece), custom (give custom_contributions). Default efka

foreign.description: Income from abroad (residents; under art. 5A/5B it is taxed flat instead)

employment.description: Foreign salary, after foreign social security, euros for 2026

other.description: Other foreign income taxed at the scale (e.g. foreign business profit), euros for 2026

tax_paid.description: Foreign tax paid on that income (credited up to the Greek tax on it), euros for 2026

investments.description: Greek investment income, tax withheld at source

advance_last_year.description: Advance tax (προκαταβολή) charged on last year's return, euros for 2026

other_withholding.description: Other tax withheld (not on Greek dividends/interest, which is counted automatically), euros for 2026

pension_withholding.description: Tax withheld from pensions, euros for 2026

wage_withholding.description: Tax withheld from salary, euros for 2026

pension_contributions.description: Health contributions withheld from the pensions, euros for 2026

regime.description: Special regime for new residents: standard; art5C (50% of salary and business income exempt for 7 years after moving to Greece); art5A (€100,000 a year flat tax on all foreign income, non-doms); art5B (7% on all foreign income, foreign pensioners). Default standard

regime_relatives.description: Art. 5A only: relatives included in the flat tax, €20,000 each

rent.description: Rent from property in Greece (ακίνητη περιουσία)

exempt.description: Rent exempt under the 36-month exemption for letting an empty home long term, euros for 2026

residency.description: Tax residence (φορολογική κατοικία): resident (worldwide income), nonResidentEU90 (EU/EEA resident with 90%+ of income from Greece: Greek income, with the tax reductions), nonResident (Greek income only; the scale rates for children and age apply, but no tax reductions of art. 16, 17 and 19). Default resident
